title: YMCA Camp Minikani

services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: Our variety of Day Camps will ensure your child a summer that parallels your own fond memories playing outside as a kid. Through creative and engaging outdoor activities, your child will explore, play and socialize with their group in a safe environment made for kids. Your child’s counselors were once campers at Minikani, and they will help your camper navigate many fun and sometimes unfamiliar activities. Throughout these experiences, your child will be safe, supported and inspired by their counselor. blurb: Between two natural lakes on 150 pristine acres, YMCA Camp Minikani is a place where campers canoe and swim; build fires and friendships; try archery and explore the arts. However, camp is much more than a series of activities or a plot of beautiful land.
